Platform STRATEGIC INSIGHTS Project Progress Custom Reports Schedule Quality & Changes PREDICT DELAYS Risk Assessment​ Completion Forecasting​ SCALE OPERATIONS Portfolio Assurance Project Collaboration​ Schedule Builds & Optimization​ Solutions BY ROLE Project Directors Project Controls Planners Investors Owners Contractors & EPCs BY SECTOR Data Centers Government Resources About Careers Company Partners Log in Talk to our team All articles AI Product Strategy March 17, 2026 Foresight Raises $25M Series A to Close the Execution Gap in the Global Infrastructure Supercycle All articles AI Product Strategy March 17, 2026 Foresight Raises $25M Series A to Close the Execution Gap in the Global Infrastructure Supercycle Today we're announcing that Foresight has raised $25 million in Series A funding, led by Macquarie Capital Venture Capital , with participation from Creandum , ISAI Build (Bouygues group VC fund managed by ISAI), i2bf Global Ventures and Somersault Ventures . This funding will accelerate product development, team expansion and global go-to-market as demand intensifies across AI infrastructure, power, defense, advanced manufacturing, energy and mobility. The execution gap is now the constraint "The scale of capital now committed to infrastructure is historic," says Igor Shifrin, Co-Founder and CEO. "But capital alone doesn't build anything on time." Unprecedented levels of investment are flowing into complex infrastructure programs—from hyperscale data centers and power generation to advanced manufacturing and defense. These programs are growing larger, more power-dense and more interdependent, relying on multi-billion-dollar delivery schedules and globally distributed supply chains. In this environment, small execution misses compound quickly into schedule slippage, cost escalation and delayed revenue. Independent research indicates that nearly 90% of large-scale infrastructure projects are delivered late or over budget. In AI infrastructure specifically, delays directly impact capacity activation, financing costs, customer commitments and competitive positioning. Capital is no longer the limiting factor. Execution is. But this isn't a technology problem or a talent problem. As Dr. Atif Ansar, Co-Founder and Executive Chairman, explains: "Delays in major projects are not rare events caused by black swans. They are systemic, driven by small, compounding execution failures and predictable human biases in planning and decision-making." The global infrastructure supercycle has exposed a gap that traditional planning and reporting tools were never built to close. A Predictive Project Delivery platform for building infrastructure at scale Foresight was built to close this gap. Our Predictive Project Delivery platform operates as a unified AI control system purpose-built for complex infrastructure programs. It establishes a reliable baseline schedule in days rather than months, continuously validates real-world progress against delivery plans, integrates execution signals across stakeholders and forecasts risk early enough for decisive intervention. The result is a living delivery model that gives owners forward-looking visibility into risk—and the ability to act before delays materialize. Customers using Foresight report: 2x more accurate completion forecasts compared to traditional bottom-up schedules 30% reduction in overruns by identifying delay drivers before escalation Portfolio-level visibility across concurrent builds, enabling risk to be managed across entire programs—not project by project Aligned with investors who understand delivery risk This round is led by Macquarie Capital Venture Capital, whose team has over 30 years of experience backing early-stage software companies at the intersection of capital markets and complex industries. "Delivery discipline is crucial in a market where delays directly impact returns," said Gary Munitz, Global Co-Head of Macquarie Capital Venture Capital. "Foresight provides project owners with the clarity and control to maintain a competitive edge." We are grateful to be building alongside partners who understand that at this scale, execution risk is capital risk. What this funding enables This Series A allows us to deepen our platform capabilities and expand our reach across three areas. First, product depth. We will continue extending the platform's ability to establish reliable schedules faster, validate real-world execution, integrate delivery signals and forecast outcomes with increasing precision—so that every level of the organization, from C-suite to field, has the tools to see risk early and act on it. Second, global deployment. We will scale our team and go-to-market to support infrastructure programs across key regions and the sectors where delivery risk is most acute. Third, sector expansion. We will extend the platform into adjacent infrastructure verticals—including power, defense and advanced manufacturing—where the same execution challenges apply at even greater scale. Closing the gap AI infrastructure, energy systems and industrial capacity will define the next decade. The organizations that deliver them predictably will protect valuations, activate capacity faster and maintain competitive positioning. Those that don't will absorb the compounding cost of delays. Delivering predictably requires more than capital allocation. It requires a reliable delivery model, continuously validated against reality, with the ability to intervene while options still exist. Foresight replaces fragmented oversight with predictive control. That is what this funding is built to scale. Want to go deeper? Talk to our team Address 101 N
